rationale: Four-question gate passes. The source is the README of @mapatlas/react. It is reusable, because consumers use it to find the React components and hooks. It is citable as a repository file. No existing page covers the React bindings. A new contributor needs to know what the package exports and what it leaves to the consumer. The patch creates one concept page for the package. It also updates map-atlas-engine and harness-neutral-specs-contract with the React-specific facts, and adds an index entry and a log entry.

edits.rationale: No existing page covers the React bindings. The source defines the package's exports, its dependencies, its peer and its wiring boundary.
The engine overview lists packages. It now records what the React bindings export and depend on, and that they keep the CSS wiring rule. It also links the new page.
The React README applies the same compiled-example and generated-peers rules. This update adds its example file to the list of evidence and links the new page.
Makes the new page reachable from the index.
Records this ingest in the append-only log.
